changes.title: Europe continues to celebrate Pride after attack on Berlin parade

changes.summary: For Greece, the danger carried grim resonance: a 2018 wildfire​ at the seaside community of Mati​, near Athens, killed 104 people.

changes.title: Four ways wildfires generate tornadoes, lightning and other extreme weather, sometimes miles from the flames
changes.summary: Thick smoke from massive wildfires has been spreading in North America and Europe once again in 2026. The health impacts of breathing this particle-filled air are becoming well known, but wildfires' influence on the weather is less widely recognized.

changes.title: Extreme Heat Has Transformed What Summer Means Across Generations in Europe
changes.summary: Rising temperatures and more frequent heat waves have changed the feel of the season for today’s children, compared with their parents and grandparents.

changes.title: Hungary to shut nuclear plant as heatwave hits central Europe
changes.summary: Hungary's sole nuclear power plant will be shut down next week because of low water levels in the Danube, Prime Minister Peter Magyar said Friday as central Europe slogs through the latest in a series of heat waves.

changes.title: Building for 131°F: Europe races to protect its infrastructure from a ‘quiet catastrophe’
changes.summary: A summer of weather extremes and severe infrastructure stress has prompted companies and policymakers across Europe to respond.
